name: pocketbook
description: A bookmark list and shelf for long conversations. Type pb bookmark -add <text> at any time, even mid-reply or with usage used up, and the item waits on the list until the agent gets to it.

interface.shortDescription: A bookmark list that waits for you
interface.longDescription: Keeps a bookmark list and a shelf in .pocketbook/. Type pb bookmark -add <text> any time, even while a reply is running or after your usage runs out; it is answered locally, without the model, and the agent picks the item up when it is done.
defaultPrompt: Add this to my bookmark list
